Name: Pelican Companions
Author: LUCASGATICA
Description:
[center][size=6][b]  Pelican Companions[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Recruit villagers and pets, build your own squad, work together, and turn friendship into progression[/b][/size]

[size=5][color=#f0c040][b]ONE MOD. ONE KEY. JUST PRESS X.[/b][/color][/size]

[b]The entire companion experience can be accessed through one contextual key.[/b]
Point at a villager, companion, resource, body of water, or safe piece of ground and press [font=Courier New]X[/font]. Recruit friends, open their profiles, give orders, assign work, send them fishing, manage the squad, or tell everyone where to go.the wheel automatically shows the actions that make sense for your target.

[i]Playing with a controller? Click the left stick to open the same complete contextual wheel.[/i]

You spent years becoming part of Pelican Town. Now you can finally achieve every farmer's dream: lovingly micromanaging your friends.

Invite villagers and pets to follow you across the valley, give them tools, send them to work, create daily routines, manage their cargo, unlock permanent skills, and watch your little team grow stronger together.

[b]It is not micromanagement if everyone gets XP.[/b]

[color=#f0c040][b]AI-FREE DEVELOPMENT DISCLAIMER[/b][/color]

The mod's original artwork was created by [url=https://www.instagram.com/onigiri_nashi/]@onigiri_nashi[/url].

You may encounter bugs or features that still need refinement. The mod will continue to be improved, polished, and expanded over time with feedback from the community.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]What Is Pelican Companions?[/b][/size][/center]

Pelican Companions is a companion and light task-assistance mod for Stardew Valley. It lets you recruit eligible villagers and pets into a temporary squad, travel with them, give them direct orders, equip them for different jobs, and develop each character through a permanent progression system.

This is not just a visual follower mod. Companions can walk with you, work in marked areas, follow hourly schedules, fish at a body of water, carry what they find, deposit items into assigned chests, react to the world, and learn skills that make them better at their role.

The goal is to make friendship feel useful and personal without turning the game into an idle simulator. You stay in control: assistance can be manual, reactive, or more autonomous depending on the task and your settings.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]✨ Feature Highlights[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Recruit villagers and pets:[/b] invite eligible NPCs after reaching the required friendship level, then dismiss and recruit them again whenever you want.[/*]
[*][b]Build a real squad:[/b] the default limit is three companions, configurable up to twelve.[/*]
[*][b]Contextual radial wheel:[/b] point at an NPC, tree, stone, mature crop, water, or safe ground and see only the commands that make sense there.[/*]
[*][b]Natural following and formations:[/b] companions travel across locations with you using Adaptive, Behind, or Compact formations and visible path recovery.[/*]
[*][b]Useful farm and valley work:[/b] companions can water crops, harvest mature grab crops, gather forage, chop mature untapped trees, mine breakable stones, clear marked areas, pet animals, and fish.[/*]
[*][b]Persistent work areas:[/b] mark an area, choose a specialty, and assign one companion or the whole local group.[/*]
[*][b]Hourly routines:[/b] paint a companion's schedule from 06:00 through 01:59 with Follow, Wait, Original Routine, Water, Wood, Mine, Clear, or Deposit blocks.[/*]
[*][b]Permanent progression:[/b] each NPC has ten levels, skill points, recent-loot history, and Lumbering, Mining, Utility, and Fishing skill branches.[/*]
[*][b]Personal inventories and equipment:[/b] manage companion cargo, tools, fishing rods, watering-can charge, and a persistent cosmetic hat.[/*]
[*][b]Chest logistics:[/b] assign chests to the whole squad or individual companions, filter automatic deposits, and move stacks between player, companion, and chest.[/*]
[*][b]Smart assistance:[/b] optionally let companions refill watering cans, borrow a compatible tool, or deposit cargo automatically.[/*]
[*][b]Personality-aware life:[/b] vanilla social NPCs have character-specific lines and can react to friendship, weather, season, time, location, work, loot, success, and failure.[/*]
[*][b]Expressive pets:[/b] cats, dogs, and turtles stay silent but communicate with hearts, question marks, jumps, shakes, and their own sounds.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer support:[/b] every farmer controls their own companions while the host safely coordinates shared world changes, inventories, chests, tasks, and progression.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse, keyboard, and controller support:[/b] the radial wheel, full panel, inventories, routines, chest assignment, and compact layouts are designed for all three.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🤝 Recruit Your Own Team[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*]Recruit the social villagers you already know, including marriage candidates and the wider Pelican Town cast.[/*]
[*]Cats, dogs, and turtles can also join your squad.[/*]
[*]The default recruitment requirement is [b]2 hearts[/b] and can be changed from 0 to 14.[/*]
[*]Your spouse and pets do not need to pass the normal friendship requirement.[/*]
[*]Squad size is configurable from 1 to 12 companions.[/*]
[*]Each multiplayer farmer owns and commands their own squad.[/*]
[*]An optional [b]Recruit All NPCs[/b] setting expands eligibility for compatible custom NPCs and unusual characters.[/*]
[*]NPC types with their own incompatible movement systems remain protected from recruitment.[/*]
[*]Dismissed villagers safely return to their original schedule.[/*]
[/list]
Recruitment is temporary, but growth is not. An NPC keeps their permanent level, learned skills, equipped tools, and cosmetic hat after leaving your active squad, ready for the next adventure.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🧭 Contextual Commands and Formations[/b][/size][/center]

Press [font=Courier New]X[/font] with the mouse over something in the world, or click the left stick on a controller, to open the contextual action wheel.

[list]
[*]Point at an unrecruited NPC to invite them.[/*]
[*]Point at a companion to open their profile, start work, make them wait, stop a task, restore their routine, follow you, or dismiss them.[/*]
[*]Point at a tree, stone, mature crop, or body of water to send one compatible companion or the whole group.[/*]
[*]Point at safe empty ground to move a companion there, dismiss the group, or begin a fixed-area work order.[/*]
[*]Large squads use wheel pages, with mouse wheel, keyboard, and controller shoulder navigation.[/*]
[/list]
Followers move at a conservative NPC speed and keep a natural distance instead of stacking directly on the farmer. Choose the formation that fits your playstyle:

[list]
[*][b]Adaptive:[/b] automatically balances spacing and available room.[/*]
[*][b]Behind:[/b] keeps the squad in a trail behind the player.[/*]
[*][b]Compact:[/b] keeps everyone closer together.[/*]
[/list]
Companions follow you between locations, recover visibly when a route is blocked, and can be recalled when the group becomes separated.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🪓 Work Together[/b][/size][/center]

Pelican Companions supports safe assistance for:

[list]
[*]Watering dry crops[/*]
[*]Harvesting mature grab crops[/*]
[*]Gathering safe forage[/*]
[*]Chopping mature, untapped trees[/*]
[*]Mining breakable stones and ore nodes[/*]
[*]Clearing supported debris inside a work area[/*]
[*]Petting farm animals[/*]
[*]Directed fishing[/*]
[/list]
Companions do not silently change the world. They walk to a valid position, reserve their target so two workers do not fight over it, use a visible tool or hand animation, and react when the job succeeds or fails.

Task behavior is configurable. Depending on the activity, you can keep it disabled, let companions mimic work you perform, issue direct manual orders, or allow nearby autonomous assistance.

[b]Built-in safety matters:[/b] the mod rechecks a target before changing it, avoids unsafe or unreachable tiles, protects flowers used by nearby bee houses, respects inventory capacity, and safely drops rewards into the world only when every configured storage route is unavailable.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🎣 Directed Companion Fishing[/b][/size][/center]

[*]Point at fishable water and use the contextual wheel.[/*]
[*]Send one rod holder or every compatible companion on the current map.[/*]
[*]They find the nearest reachable safe shore connected to that body of water.[/*]
[*]Companions continue fishing until 26:00, the end of the day, or a new command.[/*]
[*]Each regular catch grants companion XP.[/*]
[*]Fish follow the normal storage route: assigned chest, companion cargo, shared/player inventory, then a safe world drop.[/*]
[*]Fishing skills can shorten the wait between catches, improve casting range and minimum quality, and add a chance for an extra fish.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]📍 Persistent Work Areas[/b][/size][/center]

Need more than a single action? Mark safe ground and give the group an area to handle.

[list]
[*]Choose [b]Wood[/b], [b]Mining[/b], [b]Water[/b], or [b]Clear Area[/b].[/*]
[*]Assign one companion or every available worker nearby.[/*]
[*]New manual orders use your configured work radius, from 3 to 20 tiles.[/*]
[*]The order remains active across saves until the area is complete, paused, or replaced.[/*]
[*]Workers stay bounded to the selected area instead of wandering across the entire map.[/*]
[*]A companion reports when the area is complete or explains why progress is blocked.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🗓️ Hourly Companion Routines[/b][/size][/center]

Open the Routine tab and create a real daily plan for each companion.

[list]
[*]Paint twenty hourly cells from 06:00 through 01:59.[/*]
[*]Choose Follow, Wait, Original Routine, Water, Wood, Mine, Clear, or Deposit for each block.[/*]
[*]Use the one-click 06:00–18:00 work-shift shortcut when you want a quick schedule.[/*]
[*]Repeat the routine every day or run it once.[/*]
[*]Set what the companion should do when scheduled work is complete.[/*]
[*]Give each work activity its own location and area.[/*]
[*]Use [b]Free Area[/b] for the whole current map or place a [b]Delimited Area[/b] from 3 × 3 to 41 × 41 tiles.[/*]
[*]Scheduled workers can continue remote routine work even when no farmer is watching that map.[/*]
[*]A missing area never becomes accidental full-map automation; the routine pauses and tells you what it needs.[/*]
[*]Manual orders can override a routine, and [b]Follow Routine[/b] immediately returns the NPC to the current scheduled block.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]⭐ Levels and Skill Trees[/b][/size][/center]

Every companion has a permanent profile with ten levels. Work and successful actions grant XP, while new levels award points for a focused skill tree.

[b]Lumbering[/b]
[list]
[*]Increase the effective power of a companion's axe.[/*]
[*]Reduce chopping cooldown.[/*]
[*]Gain a chance for extra wood from a completed tree.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Mining[/b]
[list]
[*]Increase the effective power of a companion's pickaxe.[/*]
[*]Reduce mining cooldown.[/*]
[*]Gain a chance for extra ore from ore nodes.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Utility[/b]
[list]
[*]Retry blocked work paths sooner.[/*]
[*]Increase the companion's work search radius.[/*]
[*]Return to the player sooner after a task.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Fishing[/b]
[list]
[*]Catch fish more frequently.[/*]
[*]Cast farther and improve minimum fish quality.[/*]
[*]Gain a chance to catch an extra fish.[/*]
[/list]
Dismissal never erases progression. When an old friend joins you again, their level and learned skills return with them.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🎒 Cargo, Tools, Hats, and Chests[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Companion Cargo[/b]
[list]
[*]Each companion has a configurable inventory with up to 10 slots.[/*]
[*]Safe forage, fish, wood, stone, ore, and other normal task rewards can be carried by the worker who found them.[/*]
[*]Recent-loot history lets you see what each companion has collected.[/*]
[*]The shared squad inventory/player route provides an additional overflow fallback when enabled.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Direct Transfers[/b]
[list]
[*]The Inventory tab can show the player, companion cargo, and a nearby assigned chest at the same time.[/*]
[*]Drag a stack between panes with the mouse.[/*]
[*]On a controller, select the source and then the destination.[/*]
[*]Compact and split-screen layouts keep every pane accessible through paging.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dedicated Equipment[/b]
[/*]
[*]A dedicated cosmetic slot lets companions wear hats even after dismissal and save/reload.

[b]Deposit Chests[/b]
[list]
[*]Open a placed chest to assign it to nobody, the whole group, or specific companions.[/*]
[*]Individual assignments can override the shared squad destination.[/*]
[*]Moved assigned chests keep a persistent identity.[/*]
[*]Automatic cargo filters can store wood, store minerals, or keep food with the companion.[/*]
[*]Manual transfers stay explicit and ignore automatic deposit filters.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]💧 Smart Assistance[/b][/size][/center]

Optional automation can remove repetitive management while keeping every behavior under your control.

[list]
[*][b]Smart Water Refill:[/b] an empty equipped watering can can be refilled at reachable water on the farm or at any safe outdoor source, depending on your setting.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Tool Swap:[/b] a companion can temporarily borrow a compatible tool from the owner's inventory when no usable tool is equipped.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Deposit:[/b] filtered cargo can be routed to the assigned chest when full or after every successful task.[/*]
[*]Each smart behavior can be disabled independently.[/*]
[*]All multiplayer automation remains coordinated by the host.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]💬 Personality and Companion Life[/b][/size][/center]

The squad should feel like friends traveling together, not silent machines.

[list]
[*]The 34 social vanilla NPCs have personality-specific companion dialogue.[/*]
[*]Lines can react to friendship, season, weather, time, location, task, result, failure, and discovered items.[/*]
[*]Recent-line memory and cooldowns reduce repetitive chatter.[/*]
[*]Important work, loot, level-up, failure, and command reactions take priority over ambient comments.[/*]
[*]Idle companions can look around, emote, jump, shake, and react to location or weather changes.[/*]
[*]Nearby companions can occasionally interact with each other.[/*]
[*]Pets never speak human dialogue. They respond with expressions, movement, and their normal animal sounds.[/*]
[/list]
[b]This system uses authored, localized dialogue. It does not require generative AI.[/b]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🖥️ Companion Panel and Quick HUD[/b][/size][/center]

The full companion panel uses a warm Stardew-style interface and includes:

[list]
[*][b]Overview:[/b] level, status, current target, recent result, and companion information.[/*]
[*][b]Work:[/b] nearby work orders and specialty controls.[/*]
[*][b]Skills:[/b] permanent progression and unlockable branches.[/*]
[*][b]Inventory:[/b] player/companion/chest transfers, cargo filters, tools, and hats.[/*]
[*][b]Routine:[/b] the twenty-cell hourly schedule and saved work areas.[/*]
[*][b]Team:[/b] every owned companion's map, activity, tool, water, cargo, and blocking reason.[/*]
[/list]
The Team dashboard also provides [b]Stop All[/b], [b]Deposit All[/b], and [b]Apply Routines[/b] commands.

A collapsible quick HUD can live on the left or right side of the screen. It shows squad status, working companions, cargo pressure, quick Work/Stop/Follow actions, and a compact mode for smaller screens.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🎮 Default Controls[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]X[/font] - Open the contextual radial action wheel.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Left Stick[/font] - Open the controller action wheel.[/*]
[/list]Inside the controller wheel, use either stick or the D-pad to select, [font=Courier New]A[/font] to confirm, [font=Courier New]B[/font] to close, and the shoulder buttons to change pages.

[b]Every key can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json.[/b]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]👥 Multiplayer and Split-Screen[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*]Every farmer owns their own squad, equipment, cargo settings, routines, and commands, while each NPC keeps their permanent progression profile.[/*]
[*]The host coordinates NPC control, tasks, work reservations, chest changes, inventory transfers, and synchronized world state.[/*]
[*]Cosmetic work animations and companion reactions are synchronized to farmhands.[/*]
[*]Commands are designed to survive retries without performing the same reward or world change twice.[/*]
[*]Shared chests use safe multiplayer locking before their contents change.[/*]
[*]Farmhand crop harvesting keeps Stardew Valley's native inventory, profession, XP, quest, regrowth, and pickup behavior.[/*]
[*]Local split-screen uses the same owner-scoped model, with responsive compact interfaces.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#f0c040][b]For the fully supported multiplayer topology, every connected player must install the exact same Pelican Companions version.[/b][/color]

If an incompatible or unguarded player is connected, sensitive remote crop-harvest actions are blocked for safety. Avoid incompatible hot-joins while companion harvest work is already in progress.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/size][/center]

Pelican Companions is highly configurable. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for the easiest setup, or edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].

You can configure:

[list]
[*]Every keybind[/*]
[*]Squad size and friendship requirement[/*]
[*]Friendship gained while traveling together[/*]
[*]Companion inventory capacity[/*]
[*]Work radius and return distance[/*]
[*]Formation and quick-HUD layout[/*]
[*]Task modes for harvesting, foraging, lumbering, mining, watering, fishing, and animal petting[/*]
[*]Smart refill, smart tool swap, and smart deposit behavior[/*]
[*]Beehouse flower protection radius[/*]
[*]Dialogue, idle animation, companion interaction, and pet expression frequency[/*]
[*]Progression and level-up notifications[/*]
[*]Multiplayer disconnect behavior[/*]
[/list]
The default settings are intentionally conservative. Start with a small squad, equip the correct tools, and expand automation after you understand how your companions work.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/center]

[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] is required.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] is required.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is optional but strongly recommended.[/*]
[*]No AI provider or API key is required.[/*]
[*]AliveNpcs is not required.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher is not required.[/*]
[*]Vanilla social NPCs and the player's cats, dogs, and turtles are supported.[/*]
[*]Compatible custom NPCs can use generic companion behavior when recruitment settings allow them.[/*]
[*]NPC types with independent movement systems, monsters, invisible NPCs, horses, Junimos, farmer children, raccoons, and similar unsafe targets are excluded from recruitment.[/*]
[*]Generic stackable objects can move through companion cargo.[/*]
[*]Custom or non-stackable items whose full state cannot be safely preserved are rejected instead of being damaged.[/*]
[*]All multiplayer peers should use the exact same mod version.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]📦 Installation[/b][/size][/center]

[spoiler]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.0+[/url][/*]
[*]Optional but recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[/list]
[b]Steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download Pelican Companions.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into your Stardew Valley [font=Courier New]Mods/[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want in-game settings.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Approach an eligible villager or pet and press [font=Courier New]F5[/font], or point at them and use the [font=Courier New]X[/font] action wheel.[/*]
[*]After recruitment, press [font=Courier New]F9[/font] to open the full companion panel.[/*]
[*]Equip the correct tools before assigning tool-based jobs.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Install Pelican Companions for the host and every farmhand.[/*]
[*]Make sure every player uses the exact same version.[/*]
[*]The host's gameplay configuration is authoritative for shared systems.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
